research_question: does a metadata-only DMR-IR score come from clinical information or from records of the diagnostic pathway and the calendar
comparison: Pinto et al. 2025 Table III reports 0.918 accuracy from text embeddings of the metadata alone
post_diagnostic_rationale: biopsy, mastectomy and mammography record what the clinic did because a lesion was suspected or found
age_pair_rationale: age_current - age_at_visit is years elapsed since the visit (Pearson 0.990, five distinct values), so the pair encodes the acquisition era, which predicts the label at AUROC 0.981
lower_bound_note: their prompts also carry radiotherapy, symptoms, complaints and nipple changes, which this manifest does not hold; the leakage measured here is a lower bound on theirs
recording_defects_repaired: age_at_visit: 1 impossible value(s) [-4] set to missing
body_temperature: 4 impossible value(s) [0.0] set to missing
age_current: 1 impossible value(s) [0] set to missing
